    return A*g*g/(d*d+g*g)+c

    return sum((y-model(p,x))**2 for x,y in zip(xs,ys))

def linear_shape(xs, ys, x0, g):
    us=[]
    for x in xs:
        d=x-x0
        us.append(g*g/(d*d+g*g))
    n=len(xs)
    Suu=sum(u*u for u in us)
    Su=sum(us)
    Suy=sum(u*y for u,y in zip(us,ys))
    Sy=sum(ys)
    det=n*Suu-Su*Su
    if abs(det)<1e-12:
        return None
    A=(n*Suy-Su*Sy)/det
    c=(Suu*Sy-Su*Suy)/det
    sse=sum((y-(A*u+c))**2 for u,y in zip(us,ys))
